[31m+   return [[39m
[31m+     `M ${outerStart.x} ${outerStart.y}`,[39m
[31m+     `A ${outerR} ${outerR} 0 ${largeArc} 1 ${outerEnd.x} ${outerEnd.y}`,[39m
[31m+     `L ${innerEnd.x} ${innerEnd.y}`,[39m
[31m+     `A ${innerR} ${innerR} 0 ${largeArc} 0 ${innerStart.x} ${innerStart.y}`,[39m

[31m+ function polar(cx: number, cy: number, radius: number, angle: number) {[39m

[31m+   return [[39m
[31m+     `M ${outerStart.x} ${outerStart.y}`,[39m
[31m+     `A ${outerR} ${outerR} 0 ${largeArc} 1 ${outerEnd.x} ${outerEnd.y}`,[39m
[31m+     `L ${innerEnd.x} ${innerEnd.y}`,[39m
[31m+     `A ${innerR} ${innerR} 0 ${largeArc} 0 ${innerStart.x} ${innerStart.y}`,[39m

[31m+ function polar(cx: number, cy: number, radius: number, angle: number) {[39m
[31m+   const rad = ((angle - 90) * Math.PI) / 180;[39m

[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ function donutSegmentPath(cx: number, cy: number, outerR: number, innerR: number, startAngle: number, endAngle:
number) {[39m
[31m+   const end = Math.min(endAngle, startAngle + 359.99);[39m
[31m+   const largeArc = end - startAngle > 180 ? 1 : 0;[39m
[31m+   const outerStart = polar(cx, cy, outerR, startAngle);[39m
[31m+   const outerEnd = polar(cx, cy, outerR, end);[39m
[31m+   const innerEnd = polar(cx, cy, innerR, end);[39m
[31m+   const innerStart = polar(cx, cy, innerR, startAngle);[39m
[31m+   return [[39m
[31m+     `M ${outerStart.x} ${outerStart.y}`,[39m
[31m+     `A ${outerR} ${outerR} 0 ${largeArc} 1 ${outerEnd.x} ${outerEnd.y}`,[39m
[31m+     `L ${innerEnd.x} ${innerEnd.y}`,[39m
[31m+     `A ${innerR} ${innerR} 0 ${largeArc} 0 ${innerStart.x} ${innerStart.y}`,[39m
[31m+     'Z',[39m
[31m+   ].join(' ');[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+       <Svg width={size} height={size} viewBox="0 0 140 140">[39m
[31m+         {visible.map((row, index) => {[39m
[31m+           const angle = (row.count / total) * 360;[39m

[31m+           cursor += angle;[39m
[31m+           return <Path key={`${row.name}-${index}`} d={path} fill={row.color ?? CHART_COLORS[index %

[31m+         })}[39m
[31m+       </Svg>[39m
[31m+       <View style={{ flex: 1, gap: 7 }}>[39m

}}>{total}</Text>[39m

}}>[39m
[31m+             <View style={{ width: 9, height: 9, borderRadius: 5, backgroundColor: row.color ??
CHART_COLORS[index % CHART_COLORS.length] }} />[39m
[31m+             <Text style={{ fontSize: 8.5, color: t.text, width: 145 }}>{short(row.name, 29)}</Text>[39m

[31m+ function polar(cx: number, cy: number, radius: number, angle: number) {[39m
[31m+   const rad = ((angle - 90) * Math.PI) / 180;[39m

[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ function donutSegmentPath(cx: number, cy: number, outerR: number, innerR: number, startAngle: number, endAngle:
number) {[39m
[31m+   const end = Math.min(endAngle, startAngle + 359.99);[39m
[31m+   const largeArc = end - startAngle > 180 ? 1 : 0;[39m
[31m+   const outerStart = polar(cx, cy, outerR, startAngle);[39m
[31m+   const outerEnd = polar(cx, cy, outerR, end);[39m
[31m+   const innerEnd = polar(cx, cy, innerR, end);[39m
[31m+   const innerStart = polar(cx, cy, innerR, startAngle);[39m
[31m+   return [[39m
[31m+     `M ${outerStart.x} ${outerStart.y}`,[39m
[31m+     `A ${outerR} ${outerR} 0 ${largeArc} 1 ${outerEnd.x} ${outerEnd.y}`,[39m
[31m+     `L ${innerEnd.x} ${innerEnd.y}`,[39m
[31m+     `A ${innerR} ${innerR} 0 ${largeArc} 0 ${innerStart.x} ${innerStart.y}`,[39m
[31m+     'Z',[39m
[31m+   ].join(' ');[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+       </Svg>[39m

}}>[39m

[31m+ function polar(cx: number, cy: number, radius: number, angle: number) {[39m
[31m+   const rad = ((angle - 90) * Math.PI) / 180;[39m
[31m+   return { x: cx + radius * Math.cos(rad), y: cy + radius * Math.sin(rad) };[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ function donutSegmentPath(cx: number, cy: number, outerR: number, innerR: number, startAngle: number, endAngle:
number) {[39m
[31m+   const end = Math.min(endAngle, startAngle + 359.99);[39m
[31m+   const largeArc = end - startAngle > 180 ? 1 : 0;[39m
[31m+   const outerStart = polar(cx, cy, outerR, startAngle);[39m
[31m+   const outerEnd = polar(cx, cy, outerR, end);[39m
[31m+   const innerEnd = polar(cx, cy, innerR, end);[39m
[31m+   const innerStart = polar(cx, cy, innerR, startAngle);[39m
[31m+   return [[39m
[31m+     `M ${outerStart.x} ${outerStart.y}`,[39m
[31m+     `A ${outerR} ${outerR} 0 ${largeArc} 1 ${outerEnd.x} ${outerEnd.y}`,[39m
[31m+     `L ${innerEnd.x} ${innerEnd.y}`,[39m
[31m+     `A ${innerR} ${innerR} 0 ${largeArc} 0 ${innerStart.x} ${innerStart.y}`,[39m
[31m+     'Z',[39m
[31m+   ].join(' ');[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+       <Svg width={size} height={size} viewBox="0 0 140 140">[39m
[31m+         {visible.map((row, index) => {[39m

[31m+           cursor += angle;[39m

[31m+         })}[39m
[31m+       </Svg>[39m
[31m+       <View style={{ flex: 1, gap: 7 }}>[39m

}}>{total}</Text>[39m

}}>[39m

CHART_COLORS[index % CHART_COLORS.length] }} />[39m

[31m+ const computeNextRun = (frequency: string, startDate: string, dayOfWeek: number | null, dayOfMonth: number |

[39m
[31m+   const base = new Date(startDate);

[39m
[31m+   if (base > now) return base.toISOString();

[31m+   // Otherwise compute next occurrence from now, preserving the chosen time
[39m
[31m+   const hours = base.getHours();
[39m
[31m+   const minutes = base.getMinutes();
[39m
[31m+   switch (frequency) {
[39m
[31m+     case 'daily': {
[39m
[31m+       const next = addDays(now, 1);
[39m
[31m+       next.setHours(hours, minutes, 0, 0);
[39m
[31m+       return next.toISOString();
[39m
[31m+     }
[39m
[31m+     case 'weekly': {
[39m
[31m+       const next = setDay(startOfWeek(addWeeks(now, 1), { weekStartsOn: 1 }), dayOfWeek ?? 1);
[39m
[31m+       next.setHours(hours, minutes, 0, 0);
[39m
[31m+       return next.toISOString();
[39m
[31m+     }
[39m
[31m+     case 'biweekly': {
[39m
[31m+       const next = addWeeks(now, 2);
[39m
[31m+       next.setHours(hours, minutes, 0, 0);
[39m
[31m+       return next.toISOString();
[39m
[31m+     }
[39m
[31m+     case 'monthly': {
[39m
[31m+       const next = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth() + 1, dayOfMonth ?? 1, hours, minutes, 0, 0);
[39m
[31m+       return next.toISOString();
[39m
[31m+     }
[39m
[31m+     default:
[39m

[39m
[31m+   }
[39m
[31m+ };

[31m+ // ─── Eco wording simplifier (Ticket 16 — frontend-only, no backend changes) ──[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ const ECO_TECH_TERMS: Array<[RegExp, string]> = [[39m
[31m+   [/\bEco[\s-]?Index\b/gi, 'impact environnemental'],[39m
[31m+   [/\bEcoIndex\b/gi, 'impact environnemental'],[39m
[31m+   [/\bKOE\b/gi, 'indicateur environnemental'],[39m
[31m+   [/\bscore Eco[\s-]?Index\b/gi, 'note environnementale'],[39m
[31m+   [/\bAnalyse du Cycle de Vie\b/gi, 'évaluation des ressources'],[39m
[31m+   [/\bACV\b/g, 'évaluation des ressources'],[39m
[31m+   [/\bempreinte carbone numérique\b/gi, 'consommation de ressources'],[39m
[31m+   [/\bémissions de CO2\b/gi, 'impact des ressources'],[39m
[31m+   [/\brequêtes HTTP\b/gi, 'appels au serveur'],[39m
[31m+   [/\btaille des pages\b/gi, 'poids des pages'],[39m
[31m+   [/\bpoids des ressources\b/gi, 'poids des médias et scripts'],[39m
[31m+   [/\bgaspillage de bande passante\b/gi, 'consommation réseau'],[39m
[31m+ ];[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ export function simplifyEcoWording(text: string): string {[39m
[31m+   let result = text;[39m
[31m+   for (const [pattern, replacement] of ECO_TECH_TERMS) {[39m
[31m+     result = result.replace(pattern, replacement);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   return result;[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function simplifyEcoWordingIfNeeded(text: string, kpiId: string): string {[39m
[31m+   if (kpiId !== 'eco_index_score') return text;[39m
[31m+   return simplifyEcoWording(text);[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ /**[39m
[31m+  * Build a plain-French default description for Eco Index KPI[39m
[31m+  * that avoids backend-only jargon and explains the metric in business terms.[39m
[31m+  */[39m
[31m+ export function simplifyEcoStatut(kpiNode: any): string {[39m
[31m+   const status = String(kpiNode?.status ?? '').toLowerCase();[39m
[31m+   const score = kpiNode?.score ?? kpiNode?.data?.eco_index_score ?? kpiNode?.data?.score;[39m
[31m+   const scoreText = score !== undefined && score !== null ? ` (note ${score}/100)` : '';[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (status === 'passing') {[39m
[31m+     return `Le site a un bon impact environnemental${scoreText}. Le poids des pages, le nombre de scripts et le
volume de médias sont maîtrisés, ce qui réduit la consommation d'énergie et de ressources serveur.`;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (status === 'failing' || status === 'warning') {[39m
[31m+     return `Le site présente un impact environnemental élevé${scoreText}. Le poids des pages, les médias non
optimisés ou les scripts superflus augmentent la consommation de ressources. Optimisez les images, réduisez les
scripts inutiles et améliorez la vitesse de chargement.`;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (status === 'not_available') {[39m
[31m+     return "L'impact environnemental n'a pas pu être mesuré sur ce site. Vérifiez que les pages sont
accessibles pour permettre l'évaluation de la consommation de ressources.";[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   return "Évalue l'impact du site sur l'environnement : poids des pages, vitesse de chargement, optimisation
des médias et consommation des ressources serveur.";[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function extractScannerKpiDescription(kpiNode: any, fallbackName: string): string {[39m
[31m+   const kpiId = typeof kpiNode?.kpi_name === 'string' ? kpiNode.kpi_name.toLowerCase() : '';[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (typeof kpiNode?.constat === 'string' && kpiNode.constat.trim().length > 0) {[39m
[31m+     return simplifyEcoWordingIfNeeded(kpiNode.constat, kpiId);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (typeof kpiNode?.client_summary === 'string' && kpiNode.client_summary.trim().length > 0) {[39m
[31m+     return simplifyEcoWordingIfNeeded(kpiNode.client_summary, kpiId);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (typeof kpiNode?.info === 'string' && kpiNode.info.trim().length > 0) {[39m

[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (typeof kpiNode?.name === 'string' && kpiNode.name.trim().length > 0) {[39m

[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   // Eco default: avoid backend-only jargon when no structured text is available[39m
[31m+   if (kpiId === 'eco_index_score') {[39m

[31m+[39m
[31m+ function extractScannerKpiImpact(kpiNode: any): string | undefined {[39m
[31m+   const kpiId = typeof kpiNode?.kpi_name === 'string' ? kpiNode.kpi_name.toLowerCase() : '';[39m
[31m+   const rawImpact = typeof kpiNode?.business_impact === 'string' && kpiNode.business_impact.trim().length >

[31m+     : typeof kpiNode?.impact === 'string' && kpiNode.impact.trim().length > 0[39m

marque.';[39m

[31m+ function extractScannerKpiEvidence(kpiNode: any, urls: string[]): string[] {[39m

[31m+ function normalizeScannerOrigin(axisKey: AxisBucketKey, status: FindingStatus, kpiNode: any): FindingOrigin

[31m+ function buildFindingFromScannerKpi(axisKey: AxisBucketKey, kpiName: string, kpiNode: any): AuditFinding {[39m

[31m+   const curatedDigest = hasCuratedDigest(kpiNode);[39m
[31m+   const digestQuality = String(kpiNode?.evidence_digest?.quality ?? '').toUpperCase();[39m
[31m+   const digestRows = extractDigestRows(kpiNode);[39m

[31m+     const verifiedRows = Array.isArray(verification.rows)[39m
[31m+       ? verification.rows.filter((row: any) => {[39m

[31m+         return result === 'verifie_conforme' || result === 'risque_confirme';[39m

[31m+     : (digestSummary.length > 0 ? digestSummary : evidence.slice(0, 8));[39m

[31m+ function buildScannerAxesReport([39m
[31m+   api: ApiResponse,[39m
[31m+   auditId: string,[39m
[31m+   project: { url: string; site_name: string },[39m
[31m+ ): AuditReport {[39m
[31m+   const axisBuckets: Record<AxisBucketKey, AuditFinding[]> = {[39m
[31m+     TECHNIQUE: [],[39m
[31m+     SECURITY: [],[39m
[31m+     FUNCTIONAL: [],[39m
[31m+     PERFORMANCE: [],[39m
[31m+     SEO: [],[39m
[31m+     AI_FRIENDLY: [],[39m
[31m+     CONTENT: [],[39m
[31m+     UX_UI: [],[39m
[31m+     ECO_INDEX: [],[39m
[31m+     RGPD: [],[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const sections = api.axes ?? {};[39m
[31m+   Object.entries(sections).forEach(([apiAxisName, kpis]) => {[39m
[31m+     // Use unified resolver instead of static API_AXIS_TO_META_KEY table[39m
[31m+     const axisKey = resolveAxisMetaKey(apiAxisName);[39m
[31m+     const section = (kpis ?? {}) as RawAxisSection;[39m
[31m+     collectScannerKpiNodes(section).forEach(({ kpiName, kpiNode }) => {[39m
[31m+       const nodeKpiId = String(kpiNode?.kpi_id ?? kpiNode?.id ?? '').toLowerCase();[39m
[31m+       const aiRouteText = `${kpiName} ${nodeKpiId} ${kpiNode?.name ?? ''}`.toLowerCase();[39m
[31m+       const targetAxisKey = /ai_|ai
friendly|ai-friendly|llms|llms\.txt|seo_ai_readiness|generative|geo/.test(aiRouteText)[39m
[31m+         ? 'AI_FRIENDLY'[39m
[31m+         : axisKey;[39m
[31m+       axisBuckets[targetAxisKey].push(buildFindingFromScannerKpi(targetAxisKey, kpiName, kpiNode));[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+   });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const axes: AuditAxis[] = Object.keys(AXIS_META).map((metaKey) => {[39m
[31m+     const key = metaKey as AxisBucketKey;[39m
[31m+     const meta = AXIS_META[key];[39m
[31m+     const findings = axisBuckets[key].filter(isClientVisibleFinding);[39m
[31m+     const breakdown = getAxisScoreBreakdown({[39m
[31m+       id: meta.id,[39m
[31m+       name: meta.name,[39m
[31m+       icon: meta.id,[39m
[31m+       score: 0,[39m
[31m+       maxScore: 0,[39m
[31m+       description: meta.description,[39m
[31m+       findings,[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+     return {[39m
[31m+       id: meta.id,[39m
[31m+       name: meta.name,[39m
[31m+       icon: meta.id,[39m
[31m+       score: breakdown.x,[39m
[31m+       maxScore: breakdown.y,[39m
[31m+       scoreMeasured: breakdown.scoreMeasured,[39m
[31m+       coveragePct: breakdown.coveragePct,[39m
[31m+       measuredKpis: breakdown.measuredKpis,[39m
[31m+       totalKpis: breakdown.totalKpis,[39m
[31m+       scoreBasis: breakdown.scoreBasis,[39m
[31m+       description: meta.description,[39m
[31m+       findings,[39m
[31m+     };[39m
[31m+   });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const allFindings = axes.flatMap((axis) => axis.findings);[39m
[31m+   const passFindings = allFindings.filter((f) => f.status === 'pass');[39m
[31m+   const failFindings = allFindings.filter((f) => f.status === 'fail');[39m
[31m+   const coverageFindings: AuditFinding[] = [];[39m
[31m+   const complianceFindings = failFindings.filter((f) => f.origin === 'RGPD');[39m

[31m+ /**[39m

[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (status === 'failing' || status === 'warning') {[39m

[31m+       const targetAxisKey = /ai_|ai

[31m+   const backendHeadline = typeof backendTopLevel.headline === 'string' && backendTopLevel.headline.trim()[39m

[31m+       ? backendClient.headline.trim()[39m

[31m+   const summary: AuditSummary = {[39m
[31m+     total,[39m

[31m+     high: backendHigh ?? failFindings.filter((f) => f.criticality === 'high').length,[39m
[31m+     medium: backendMedium ?? failFindings.filter((f) => f.criticality === 'medium').length,[39m
[31m+     low: backendLow ?? failFindings.filter((f) => f.criticality === 'low').length,[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const passingKpis: AuditPassingKpi[] = passFindings.map((f) => ({[39m
[31m+     id: f.id,[39m
[31m+     label: f.title,[39m

[31m+     status: 'pass',[39m

[31m+   }));[39m

[31m+ /**[39m
[31m+  * Resolve the French display labels (statut, typeLabel, priorite) for a KPI.[39m
[31m+  *[39m
[31m+  * Uses the per-KPI rule table when the KPI ID is known, then falls back to[39m
[31m+  * a generic default that matches the plan's contract rules.[39m
[31m+  */[39m
[31m+ function resolveKpiLabels([39m
[31m+   kpiId: string,[39m
[31m+   rawStatus: string | undefined | null,[39m
[31m+   severity: string | null | undefined,[39m
[31m+   data: any,[39m
[31m+ ): KpiLabels {[39m
[31m+   const status = String(rawStatus ?? '').toLowerCase();[39m
[31m+   const normalizedKpiId = kpiId.replace(/[^a-z0-9_]/g, '').toLowerCase();[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   // Keep one public label for all inconclusive executions. Collected fingerprints[39m
[31m+   // remain visible in evidence without turning an unmeasured KPI into a failure.[39m
[31m+   if (isNonTestedStatus(status)) {[39m
[31m+     const ruleForNT = KPI_LABEL_RULES[normalizedKpiId];[39m
[31m+     if (ruleForNT) {[39m
[31m+       const result = ruleForNT(status, severity, data);[39m
[31m+       if (result) return result;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     return NT_DEFAULT;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   // Check for passing[39m
[31m+   if (status === 'passing' || status === 'pass' || status === 'covered') {[39m
[31m+     return OK_DEFAULT;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   // For failing/warning, look up per-KPI rule[39m
[31m+   const rule = KPI_LABEL_RULES[normalizedKpiId];[39m
[31m+   if (rule) {[39m
[31m+     const result = rule(status, severity, data);[39m
[31m+     if (result) return result;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   // Default fallback for unknown KPIs[39m
[31m+   if (status === 'warning') {[39m
[31m+     return KO_RECO_MIN; // warnings → Recommandation/Mineure[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   return koBugOrReco(severity); // failing → severity-dependent[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ type AxisBucketKey = keyof typeof AXIS_META;[39m
[31m+ type RawAxisSection = Record<string, any>;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ /**[39m
[31m+  * Normalize axis labels to uppercase, remove accents, and standardize separators.[39m
[31m+  * @example "Sécurité" -> "SECURITE", "Check Sécurité" -> "CHECK_SECURITE"[39m
[31m+  */[39m
[31m+ function normalizeAxisLabel(label: string): string {[39m
[31m+   if (!label || typeof label !== 'string') return '';[39m
[31m+   [39m
[31m+   return label[39m
[31m+     .trim()[39m
[31m+     .toLowerCase()[39m
[31m+     // Remove accents/diacritics using NFD normalization[39m
[31m+     .normalize('NFD')[39m
[31m+     .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')[39m
[31m+     .toUpperCase()[39m
[31m+     // Replace spaces, hyphens, slashes with underscores[39m
[31m+     .replace(/[\s\-/]+/g, '_')[39m
[31m+     // Collapse multiple underscores[39m
[31m+     .replace(/_+/g, '_')[39m
[31m+     // Clean up leading/trailing underscores[39m
[31m+     .replace(/^_+|_+$/g, '');[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ /**[39m
[31m+  * Unified axis alias table: mapped from normalized label → AXIS_META key.[39m
[31m+  * Includes French and English synonyms with accents stripped.[39m
[31m+  */[39m
[31m+ const AXIS_ALIAS_TABLE: Record<string, AxisBucketKey> = {[39m
[31m+   // TECHNIQUE aliases[39m

[31m+   return 'not_measured';[39m

[31m+[39m
[31m+ const ECO_TECH_TERMS: Array<[RegExp, string]> = [[39m

[31m+   [/\bEcoIndex\b/gi, 'impact environnemental'],[39m
[31m+   [/\bKOE\b/gi, 'indicateur environnemental'],[39m

[31m+   [/\bempreinte carbone numérique\b/gi, 'consommation de ressources'],[39m
[31m+   [/\bémissions de CO2\b/gi, 'impact des ressources'],[39m
[31m+   [/\brequêtes HTTP\b/gi, 'appels au serveur'],[39m
[31m+   [/\btaille des pages\b/gi, 'poids des pages'],[39m

[31m+ export function simplifyEcoWording(text: string): string {[39m
[31m+   let result = text;[39m

[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   return result;[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ /**[39m
[31m+  * Build a plain-French default description for Eco Index KPI[39m

[31m+ export function simplifyEcoStatut(kpiNode: any): string {[39m

scripts inutiles et améliorez la vitesse de chargement.`;[39m

[31m+       const targetAxisKey = /ai_|ai

[31m+         ? 'AI_FRIENDLY'[39m
[31m+         : axisKey;[39m

[31m+     });[39m

[31m+   const readBackendInt = (key: string): number | undefined => {[39m

[31m+[39m

[31m+   const backendHeadline = typeof backendTopLevel.headline === 'string' && backendTopLevel.headline.trim()[39m

[31m+     high: backendHigh ?? failFindings.filter((f) => f.criticality === 'high').length,[39m
[31m+     medium: backendMedium ?? failFindings.filter((f) => f.criticality === 'medium').length,[39m
[31m+     low: backendLow ?? failFindings.filter((f) => f.criticality === 'low').length,[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const passingKpis: AuditPassingKpi[] = passFindings.map((f) => ({[39m
[31m+     id: f.id,[39m

[31m+   }));[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const auditCoverage: AuditCoverageItem[] = [];[39m

[31m+   return {[39m

[31m+     siteName: project.site_name,[39m

[31m+     globalScore,[39m
[31m+     maturityLevel: globalScore >= 75 ? 'Avancé' : globalScore >= 50 ? 'Intermédiaire' : 'En développement',[39m

[31m+     strategicSummary: backendHeadline || `Audit base sur ${allFindings.length} controles affiches

[31m+     positivePoints: passFindings.slice(0, 6).map((f) => f.title),[39m

[31m+       .map((f) => f.title),[39m

[31m+       .filter((f) => f.criticality !== 'critical' && f.criticality !== 'high')[39m
[31m+       .slice(0, 6)[39m
